📉✅ "#Juventus's goal was to lower the squad costs by 15%. And, more or less, the bianconero management succeeded: we are right around that percentage."[Cristiano Corbo - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

❌ "For those asking if #Juventus will sign anyone from the free agent market, there is absolutely no indication that the club is interested in pursuing this path: there is an overbooking in the squad lists."[Romeo Agresti - IlBianconero via @juventusinsidernews]

Last time we had 3 players born in Germany in the team, we won Scudetto and Coppa Italia 🇮🇹 (2017-2018). 2 out of 3 with double citizenship. 🇩🇪🇹🇷 Can 🇩🇪 🇹🇳 Khedira 🇩🇪 Höwedes🇩🇪🇹🇷 Yildiz 🇩🇪🇧🇦 Alajbegovic 🇩🇪 Woltemade

🇫🇷ℹ️ "We will see #Thuram again in 2027. I have read many things - like he perhaps did not follow the instructions from #Juventus - but I highly doubt that. The club tries to completely protect its assets and its technical heritage, they don't play around with a player's health. If the initial consultations had shown that immediate surgical intervention was required, it would have happened."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🔚👋 "#Zhegrova's exclusion makes it very clear that #Juventus is working toward a solution while transfer markets are still open. The exclusion also coincides with the return of Nico #González, whom #Spalletti has decided to rely on heavily. The message to the Kosovar seems very clear: find yourself a team, there is no longer room for you here."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
